posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
We will definitely be at Gen Con this year! We will have a slightly larger booth than last year (unless some space magically frees up, and we can get a much larger booth than last year).

 

We will also be at PAX East this year! If you are attending, come check us out! We'll have a 20x30 booth in the main expo hall (unlike last year, when we were in Tabletop).

@jagarciao - PAX badges sell out in approximately 6 hours. However, if you would still like to attend this year, I know a guy who can get you a badge! That guy is me, and all I ask in return is that you spend half of the expo hall hours (about 12 hours all told over the 3 day show) running demo games for us in our booth. If you (or anyone else!) are interested, let me know!
